login.signInSubtitle: Sign in to manage your Minecraft servers.
login.totpSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.emailSubtitle: We sent a six-digit code to your address. It expires shortly.

gate.unreachableBody: Obsidian's API did not answer. Check that the server is running, then try again.

setup.headline: Set up Obsidian
setup.subtitle: Create the administrator account. You can change everything here later in Settings.

errors.username: Choose a username for the administrator.
errors.stopTimeout: Graceful stop timeout must be a whole number of seconds between 5 and 600.
errors.smtp: Enter the SMTP host and the sender address, or turn email off.

setup.adminEmailHint: Optional. Needed for password resets and email sign-in codes.
setup.smtpToggleHint: Enables password resets and emailed sign-in codes. You can skip this and add it later.
setup.smtpTestHint: Send a test message from Settings after setup, once an administrator email is on the account.
setup.publicUrlHint: Used in invite and password reset links.
setup.stopTimeoutHint: How long a server gets to shut down after `stop` before it is killed.
setup.upnp: Forward server ports with UPnP by default
setup.upnpHint: New instances start with UPnP port forwarding switched on.

reset.requestSubtitle: Enter the email address on your account and we will send a reset link.
reset.requestSent: If an account matches that address, a reset link is on its way. The link expires after a short time.
reset.chooseSubtitle: Setting a new password signs you out everywhere.
reset.done: Your password has been updated. You can sign in with it now.

invite.checkingSubtitle: One moment while we verify the link.
invite.expiredBody: Invites can be used once and expire after a few days. Ask an administrator for a new link.
invite.headline: Join the panel
invite.subtitle: Create your account to start managing servers.
invite.emailHint: Optional. Used for password resets and sign-in codes.
